title: Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Schedule of Cancellation Charges and Refund Terms
content:
Schedule of cancellation figures and refund terms for Entry & Patio Door Contracts.

| Door series | Cooling-off period after signing | Cooling-off refund window after the notice is received | Charge retained on cancellation in status signed (pre-measure cancellation fee) | Measure-and-design charge retained on cancellation in status measured | Share of the adjusted contract value charged on cancellation after order release | Refund window for other refunds |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 3 business days | 10 business days | $150.00 | $295.00 | 60% | 10 business days |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 3 business days | 10 business days | $150.00 | $325.00 | 62% | 10 business days |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 3 business days | 10 business days | $175.00 | $345.00 | 60% | 10 business days |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 3 business days | 10 business days | $175.00 | $375.00 | 64% | 10 business days |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 3 business days | 10 business days | $195.00 | $425.00 | 62% | 10 business days |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 3 business days | 10 business days | $225.00 | $495.00 | 70% | 10 business days |

## Definitions

- **Cooling-off period**: the business days after the contract signing date during which an in-home sale may be cancelled under the federal three-day cooling-off right printed on the contract.
- **Cooling-off refund window**: the business days after receipt of a qualifying cooling-off notice within which every payment is refunded.
- **Pre-measure cancellation fee**: the charge retained when a contract outside the cooling-off right is cancelled in status signed.
- **Measure-and-design charge**: the charge retained when a contract outside the cooling-off right is cancelled in status measured.
- **Product share**: the share of the adjusted contract value charged when a contract is cancelled after order release.
- **Refund window**: the business days within which a non-cooling-off cancellation refund or an overpayment refund is issued after it becomes due.
- **Refund tender rule**: every series uses the original tender rule. Original tender means a refund goes back to the card or account the payment came from, and a check is mailed for cash or check payments.

## Hypothetical reading

A Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door contract outside the cooling-off right corresponds to $225.00 when cancelled in status signed, $495.00 when cancelled in status measured, and 70% of the adjusted contract value when cancelled after order release. The cooling-off period is 3 business days and both refund windows are 10 business days in every series.
